jp: どの者を召喚したいと願うか？
jp_grezzo: "どの者を召喚したいと願うか？"
en: Which one do you wish to summon?
en_grezzo: "Which one do you wish to summon?"

jp: は、あなたの世界に召喚された！
jp_grezzo: "は、あなたの世界に召喚された！"
en: has been summoned to your world!
en_grezzo: " has been summoned to your world!"
it: risponde alla chiamata ed entra nel tuo mondo!

jp: その魔法には使えない。
en: Bonuses can't be used for that spell.
en_grezzo: "Bonuses can't be used for that spell."
it: I bonus non si possono spendere su quell'incantesimo.

jp: W/Sキーで縦サイズ調整、A/Dキーで横サイズ調整、Z/Xキーで角度調整。
jp_grezzo: "W/Sキーで縦サイズ調整、A/Dキーで横サイズ調整、Z/Xキーで角度調整。"
en: Item Mark: W/S: adjust length, A/D: adjust width, Z/X: rotate angle, Q/E: adjust size.
en_grezzo: "Item Mark: W/S: adjust length, A/D: adjust width, Z/X: rotate angle, Q/E: adjust size."
it: Segno oggetto: W/S altezza, A/D larghezza, Z/X angolo, Q/E dimensione.

jp: 移動キーでマーク移動、Gキーで前後切替、Fキーで左右反転、RキーでReset。
jp_grezzo: "移動キーでマーク移動、Gキーで前後切替、Fキーで左右反転、RキーでReset。"
en: ARROW keys to move, G key to switch side, F to flip, R to reset position.
en_grezzo: "           ARROW keys to move, G key to switch side, F to flip, R to reset position."
it: Cursore per spostare, G davanti/dietro, F specchia, R azzera.

jp: Enterキーで決定、キャンセルキーで終了、Kキーで削除し終了。
jp_grezzo: "Enterキーで決定、キャンセルキーで終了、Kキーで削除し終了。"
en: ENTER key to save, SHIFT key to cancel and exit, K to delete and exit.
en_grezzo: "           ENTER key to save, SHIFT key to cancel and exit, K to delete and exit."
it: Invio salva, Shift annulla ed esce, K cancella ed esce.

jp: 上下キーで縦サイズ調整、左右キーで横サイズ調整、zxキーで角度調整、Enterキーで決定、キャンセルキーで終了。
jp_grezzo: "上下キーで縦サイズ調整、左右キーで横サイズ調整、zxキーで角度調整、Enterキーで決定、キャンセルキーで終了。"
en: Up and down keys to adjust item mark length, left and right keys to adjust item mark width, z and x keys to adjust item mark angle, hit the enter key to decide the position, hit the cancel key to exit.
en_grezzo: "Up and down keys to adjust item mark length, left and right keys to adjust item mark width, z and x keys to adjust item mark angle, hit the enter key to decide the position, hit the cancel key to exit."
it: Su/Giù altezza, Sinistra/Destra larghezza, z/x angolo, Invio conferma, Annulla esce.

jp: 左右キーで選択、Enterキーで決定、キャンセルキーでキャンセル。
jp_grezzo: "左右キーで選択、Enterキーで決定、キャンセルキーでキャンセル。"
en: Left and right keys to change graphic, hit the enter key to decide, hit the cancel key to exit.
en_grezzo: "Left and right keys to change graphic, hit the enter key to decide, hit the cancel key to exit."
it: Sinistra/Destra per cambiare immagine, Invio conferma, Annulla esce.
